description.p: FastTIFF is a fast viewer for large multi-frame scientific TIFF stacks (ImageJ hyperstacks and OME-TIFF). It memory-maps the file and renders frames on the GPU, so scrubbing through a multi-gigabyte stack stays instant, with no per-frame CPU image processing for the common uncompressed case.

ul.li: 2D movie scrubbing and a GPU ray-marched 3D volume view
8/16/32/64-bit integer and 32/64-bit float, grayscale, composite and RGB
Per-channel contrast, LUTs, colormaps, and pseudocolor
